chunks: Kill Joseph or cast him in some distant land so that we may get our father's exclusive affection; then play innocent.

key_terms.يَخْلُ: to become clear/free (of his love for Joseph)

ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers propose doing to him to win their father's affection?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Yusuf, the brothers propose two options—killing Joseph or casting him into a well—to remove the rival for their father Jacob’s affection, aiming to restore familial harmony through his absence. This reflects the pre-Islamic Arab concept of *suffah* (righteousness) often used to justify pragmatic or even ruthless actions for the sake of family unity. The narrative highlights the tension between sibling rivalry and paternal favoritism, a central theme in the story of the prophets.
